mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, total_price, payment_status, used_point, user_coupon_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentStatus}, #{usedPoint}, #{userCouponId})
INSERT INTO orders_item (order_id, product_id, quantity, price) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.user_id AS userId, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.ordered_at AS createdAt, o.used_point AS usedPoint, o.user_coupon_id AS userCouponId, u.name AS userName, oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price AS price, p.name AS itemName, p.image_url AS imageUrl FROM ( SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 50 ) o LEFT JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN orders_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id ASC

SELECT order_id AS orderId, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, payment_status AS paymentStatus, order_status AS orderStatus, ordered_at AS createdAt, used_point AS usedPoint, user_coupon_id AS userCouponId FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price AS price, p.name AS name, p.image_url AS imageUrl FROM orders_item oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
